headline: German and Danish police investigate bomb threats sent to schools across both countries
label: NEWS
caption:
Schools in Germany and Denmark received alarming bomb threats via email leading to ongoing police investigations. 🚨

According to authorities, schools in the German capital of Berlin and the Danish capital of Copenhagen were among those targeted by identical email warnings. German police stated that around 450 schools were affected across multiple states in the country.

Authorities quickly concluded that the threats did not represent a concrete danger and were not serious. Police in Thuringia said schools were told to continue as normal because the apparent intention was to scare people without taking action.

In Denmark, police also confirmed there was no immediate danger while investigating the threats directed at schools across the country. Similar hoax threats have hit schools, supermarkets and public buildings across Europe in recent weeks.
